title: What is the best AI to generate pixel sprite characters?
author: Apprehensive-Ear7504
selftext: I need the absolute best quality AI sprite generator.

comments.author: xens999
comments.body: Pixellabs is the best I've found personally.

replies.author: BrockFoster
replies.body: Can it match existing art styles?

replies.author: xens999
replies.body: You can give it reference art yeah. Connect to it with whatever ai you are using and just give it instructions on what you want, that's the easiest way.

replies.author: xens999
replies.body: I have a couple referral codes if anyone wants to try it out for a month. Its definately the easist/best results I've found. DGQWLO\_MONTHLY\_TIER\_1 & DGQWLO\_MONTHLY\_TIER\_2

comments.body: I am really interested in the Gaussian art style.

comments.author: ferrx
comments.body: I used them all and they all have issues. Don’t waste money in 2026 on this.

comments.author: stolenyourgf
comments.body: PixelLab and Retro Diffusion output real grid-aligned pixels; general models give off-grid 'pixel-style'. Quality comes more from post-processing: nearest-neighbour downscale to real size, snap to one shared palette, then fix stray pixels, outlines and light direction by hand, especially across animation frames.

comments.author: crackedpotstudio
comments.body: Pixellab MCP through claude code with an pixelartist agent is the easiest way for me
